name: STAC Machine Learning Model Extension Ontology
title: Definitions for STAC MLM extension elements
description: Vocabulary defining the elements of the STAC Machine Learning Model (MLM) extension: model identity, framework/accelerator requirements, and the ModelInput/ModelOutput/InputStructure/ResultStructure/ValueScaling structures, providing Linked Data terms for the STAC MLM schema. Tasks, framework, accelerator, resize_type and value-scaling type are modeled as skos:ConceptSchemes; everything else stays OWL. Reuses classification:classes (Classification extension) and aligns with processing:expression (Processing extension) rather than redefining them.
